How to use the Service Desk

Everything after a customer complains: triage it, put a technician on it, and close it inside the SLA the company promises (24 hours to respond).

Do this, in order

  1. Open the complaint from Open Requests. The pump's full history is already on the form - check Repeat Failure before assuming it is a fresh fault.
  2. Set Technician and Service Centre, then set status to Assigned. The response clock stops when you fill First Response.
  3. The technician records what happened in a Service Visit: findings, parts used, labour. Warranty jobs default to non-chargeable.
  4. Close the request with a Root Cause. That field is what feeds the Pareto chart and tells the factory what to fix.

Watch out for

  • SLA Breaches is the list to clear first thing every morning.
  • If the root cause is a Manufacturing Defect, raise a Warranty Claim so the batch gets analysed - otherwise the plant never learns.
